title: Acknowledgement bits
description:
Build and read the ack field games use to confirm many packets at once.

```
received: 100, 99, 97, 96 (98 lost)
ack = 100, bits = 0b...1101 (99 yes, 98 no, 97 yes, 96 yes)
sender learns: 100 99 97 96 arrived, 98 lost
```
hints: When `seq` is newer by `d`, shift `bits` left by `d`, set bit `d - 1` for the old latest, and make `seq` the latest (lesson 5.03).
An older `seq` sets bit `latest - 1 - seq`, if that is below 32.
requirements: The receiver keeps the latest sequence number and a 32-bit field: bit n means `latest - 1 - n` arrived.
`onReceive(seq)` updates both (shifting the field when a newer packet arrives).
The sender turns `(ack, bits)` into the list of acknowledged packets.
stretch: Combine it with the wrap-around comparison from the previous project.
